definitions.gloss: rack; shelf; stand; frame for storage or display
definitions.explanation: An open framework or shelving structure used for organizing, storing, or displaying items. Common in homes, offices, and shops.

examples.japanese: {本|ほん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ラック⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{並|なら}べた→並べる：01091_naraberu⟧。
examples.english: I lined up the books on the rack.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧ラック⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}って→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{片付|かたづ}けた→片付ける：01192_katazukeru⟧。
examples.english: I bought a new rack and tidied up the room.

examples.japanese: ⟦サーバー→サーバー：04755_saabaa⟧ラック⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{設置|せっち}→設置：09750_secchi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{十分|じゅうぶん}→十分：01614_juubun⟧な⟦スペース→スペース：11049_supeesu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{冷却|れいきゃく}→冷却：09796_reikyaku⟧⟦{設備|せつび}→設備：03301_setsubi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: Installing a server rack requires sufficient space and cooling equipment.

notes:
From English "rack." A broadly used loanword for various types of open shelving and storage frames. Unlike ⟦{棚|たな}→棚：01650_tana⟧ (shelf), ラック emphasizes the open-frame structure and often implies something that can be assembled or reconfigured.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- メタルラック: metal rack; wire shelving
- マガジンラック: magazine rack
- ⟦スパイス→スパイス：11054_supaisu⟧ラック: spice rack
- ⟦サーバー→サーバー：04755_saabaa⟧ラック: server rack
- ラック⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{置|お}く→置く：01092_oku⟧: to put on a rack
- ラック⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{組|く}み{立|た}てる→組み立てる：04661_kumitateru⟧: to assemble a rack

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{棚|たな}→棚：01650_tana⟧: shelf — a native Japanese word for any shelf, including built-in or enclosed shelving
- シェルフ: shelf — a less common English loanword, used mainly in furniture branding
- ⟦スタンド→スタンド：00394_sutando⟧: stand — for vertical display or holding a single item upright
